notes: The whole daily flow, connected. NEW: your Daily plan now has 'Send check-out sheet' and 'Send check-in sheet' buttons — one tap loads your picks or returns (with bins and quantities) into the transfer cart and emails your parts dept; when they reply, your truck updates itself. New techs get a clear 'Let's load your truck' start instead of a dead end. Pick/Return amounts are bold and color-coded so the list reads at a glance. Tips and empty screens rewritten to match the real flow.
